newsitem.title: USA: Most IMM currencies finish with moderate losses.
newsitem.headline: Most IMM currencies finish with moderate losses.

text.p: Sep 6 - Most IMM currencies ended moderately lower. Early action choppy after U.S. jobs report, late action mostly on the downside as dollar, T-bond soared. Sept Aussie dollar hit fresh contract high on technicals, ideas a rate-cut there is unlikely soon. Canadian dollar sinks, succombing to weak tone set on Thursday. Overall volume light to heavy, traders said. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
